name: Claude Fable 5.1
summary: Run longer coding and agent sessions for about 25% less than Fable 5 — up to 45% on agentic work, thanks to a 75% cut in cache-read pricing. One million tokens of context, 128K output per response.

name: OpenClaw 2.0
summary: Run an open-source agent that sets itself up from what you already have — a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, API keys, or local models. The rebuilt browser app does setup by conversation.

name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
summary: Stretch a generated clip out to 40 seconds in ten-second chunks, pin the first and last frames to storyboard a shot, then upscale to 4K. Draft at 360p for $0.03 a second first.

name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
summary: Transcribe recorded or live audio in 85+ languages with speaker labels, word-level timestamps, and up to 1,000 custom vocabulary terms. Roughly half a cent a minute, and there's a free tier.

name: Built-in browser in Cowork
summary: Hand off web chores — filling forms, pulling numbers out of a dashboard — to a browser that lives inside the desktop app. No extension to install, and it never touches your own tabs or passwords.

name: GLM-5.3-Flash
summary: Run a frontier-grade coding and agent model yourself — MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, a 1M-token context, image and video input. Or call the hosted API at a tenth of the previous GLM's price.

name: Granite 4.2
summary: Run a reasoning model on your own hardware — 3B, 8B, and 30B weights under Apache 2.0, free from Hugging Face and Ollama. A thinking switch turns step-by-step reasoning on or off. 128K context.

name: Keenable Search API
summary: Add live web search and clean page text to an agent without paying upfront. The public endpoint needs no key, and a free account includes 100,000 searches a month.
